other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh.
Applicant must be a woman construction worker.
Applicant must be registered with the Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must possess a beneficiary identity card at least 90 days before the scheme application date.
Benefit is provided only for the first two children of the worker.
In case of the death of the female worker during delivery, the assistance payment will be made to her husband.
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum amount of ₹20,000 is paid to the registered female construction worker after the birth of the child.
